import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from datetime import datetime

# Data
data = {
    'ID': [5524, 2174, 4141, 6182, 5324],
    'Year_Birth': [1957, 1954, 1965, 1984, 1981],
    'Education': ['Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'Graduation', 'PhD'],
    'Marital_Status': ['Single', 'Single', 'Together', 'Together', 'Married'],
    'Income': [58138.0, 46344.0, 71613.0, 26646.0, 58293.0],
    'Kidhome': [0, 1, 0, 1, 1],
    'Teenhome': [0, 1, 0, 0, 0],
    'Dt_Customer': ['04-09-2012', '08-03-2014', '21-08-2013', '10-02-2014', '19-01-2014'],
    'Recency': [58, 38, 26, 26, 94],
    'MntWines': [635, 11, 426, 11, 173],
    'MntFruits': [88, 1, 49, 4, 43],
    'MntMeatProducts': [546, 6, 127, 20, 118],
    'MntFishProducts': [172, 2, 111, 10, 46],
    'MntSweetProducts': [88, 1, 21, 3, 27],
    'MntGoldProds': [88, 6, 42, 5, 15],
    'NumDealsPurchases': [3, 2, 1, 2, 5],
    'NumWebPurchases': [8, 1, 8, 2, 5],
    'NumCatalogPurchases': [10, 1, 2, 0, 3],
    'NumStorePurchases': [4, 2, 10, 4, 6],
    'NumWebVisitsMonth': [7, 5, 4, 6, 5],
    'AcceptedCmp3': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp4': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp5': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp1': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp2': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Complain': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Z_CostContact': [3, 3, 3, 3, 3],
    'Z_Revenue': [11, 11, 11, 11, 11],
    'Response': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert date column
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')
df['Age'] = datetime.now().year - df['Year_Birth']

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Income vs Age scatter plot
plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Age', y='Income', hue='Marital_Status', 
                size='Kidhome', sizes=(50, 200), alpha=0.7)
plt.title('Income vs Age by Marital Status & Kids')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Income')

# 2. Product spending comparison
plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
product_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
product_totals = df[product_cols].sum()
product_totals.plot(kind='bar', color=sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_cols)))
plt.title('Total Spending by Product Category')
plt.xlabel('Product Category')
plt.ylabel('Total Amount')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# 3. Purchase channels comparison
plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_totals = df[purchase_cols].sum()
purchase_totals.plot(kind='bar', color=sns.color_palette('Set2'))
plt.title('Total Purchases by Channel')
plt.xlabel('Purchase Channel')
plt.ylabel('Number of Purchases')
plt.xticks(rotation=0)

# 4. Income distribution by education
plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', palette='pastel')
plt.title('Income Distribution by Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Education')
plt.ylabel('Income')

# 5. Recency distribution
plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Recency', bins=10, kde=True, color='skyblue')
plt.title('Distribution of Days Since Last Purchase')
plt.xlabel('Recency (Days)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')

# 6. Customer acquisition timeline
plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('Dt_Customer')
plt.plot(df_sorted['Dt_Customer'], df_sorted['Income'], marker='o', linewidth=2)
plt.title('Customer Acquisition Timeline')
plt.xlabel('Acquisition Date')
plt.ylabel('Income')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# 7. Household composition
plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
household_data = df[['Kidhome', 'Teenhome']].sum()
household_data.plot(kind='pie', autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
plt.title('Household Composition')
plt.ylabel('')

# 8. Correlation heatmap of spending categories
plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
correlation_matrix = df[product_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
plt.title('Spending Categories Correlation')

# 9. Multi-channel behavior
plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
channel_data = df[['NumWebPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumWebVisitsMonth']].mean()
channel_data.plot(kind='bar', color=['lightgreen', 'orange', 'lightblue'])
plt.title('Average Channel Engagement')
plt.xlabel('Channel')
plt.ylabel('Average Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=0)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
